summary: Frontend-only validation of new /startup-market presentation (27 slides) + light regression on /trackers. All requested functional criteria pass: cover renders with Hop.Agency × Startup Drive wordmark and Дмитрий Бондарев author/photo; Далее navigates through all 27 slides with no errors/blank screens and is disabled on slide 27; Назад is disabled on slide 1 and navigates back correctly; counter shows NN / 27 (padded e.g. '07 / 27', '27 / 27'); dot-navigation (sm-dot-0..26) jumps directly to selected slide including final dark slide 'Выигрывают компании, которые могут доказать зрелость' via sm-dot-26; all 8 chart slides (1-based positions 6,7,8,9,10,11,19,24) render exactly one visible with naturalWidth>0 (no broken images); keyboard ArrowRight/ArrowLeft advance/retreat slides; PDF button is initially disabled with spinner and becomes enabled within <0.5s after pre-generation completes, opens a menu with both 'Светлая тема' (sm-pdf-light) and 'Тёмная тема' (sm-pdf-dark) links having valid blob: hrefs; both blobs start with %PDF- and are ~4.8 MB each (light=4,804,929 B, dark=4,803,996 B), confirming valid PDFs with embedded charts. /trackers regression: cover ('Введение в стартапы', Дмитрий Бондарев) still loads correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Console floods 'Buffer is not defined' warnings (~70+) emitted from PDF generator pipeline (likely pdf-lib/pngjs polyfill missing) while it still produces valid PDFs. Non-fatal but noisy — consider providing a Buffer polyfill or switching to a browser-native API to silence warnings.
StartupMarketPresentation.jsx is fine in size (~156 lines); slide deck is well split into 27 small components. No DRY/file-size issues.
Slide counter uses non-breaking space ( ) around '/' — fine visually; just note for future tests using text matchers (use \u00A0 or partial match).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route /startup-market — 27 slides, testids: sm-presentation, sm-prev-btn, sm-next-btn, sm-pdf-btn, sm-pdf-light, sm-pdf-dark, sm-dot-{0..26}. Charts at 1-based slides 6,7,8,9,10,11,19,24 use /images/startup-market/light/VIS-0X.svg (Топ-10 text is in img alt, not visible). Counter format is zero-padded NN / 27 with non-breaking spaces. PDF pre-gen emits harmless 'Buffer is not defined' console warnings but produces valid PDFs (%PDF- header, ~4.8MB each). Keyboard ArrowRight/Down/Space advance; ArrowLeft/Up retreat (handled on window keydown). Detection of active dot via getComputedStyle bg = rgb(27,58,91) can be flaky right after a key press; allow ~300ms or query React state via a less brittle method.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — task implementation matches all acceptance criteria.
